name: Wallpaper FX
description:
Animated wallpapers drawn by your GPU: aurora, nebulae, starfields, snow, rain and more. Nineteen patterns you can stack and tune, or let the weather outside choose, painted behind your windows and in the overview.

The patterns hold still when animations are off (GNOME also turns them off in virtual machines without 3D acceleration and in remote-desktop sessions), in power-saver mode, and optionally on battery. The Accent, Color and Custom Picture backgrounds replace the wallpaper the shell draws without changing your wallpaper setting. Gradients are cached as images in ~/.cache/wallpaper-fx.

Follow the Weather, off until you turn it on, is the only thing that uses the network. It follows the first place in your GNOME Weather list and never asks for your location itself: through GWeather it sends that town's coordinates to MET Norway, and its station code to aviationweather.gov.
